modules.scope: Minimal header-only compiler, invariant, version-value and cache-layout foundation.
modules.non_goals: Runtime version artifact, cache-topology discovery, native FFI and owning-module performance claims.
known_limitations: Compiler hints remain preconditioned and do not guarantee a cache hit or a chosen lowering.
Runtime topology and crash-reporting policy remain with their owning modules.
reopen_triggers: A real consumer exposes a correctness, security or missing-foundation defect.
A supported compiler or target invalidates the frozen code-generation contract.
A direct dependency changes Core semantics, or the public component/delivery boundary changes.
A strong peer proves a better complexity class or a reproducible material advantage for the same consumer contract.
modules.summary: P0 基础层已关闭；消费者性能声明由所属模块承担。

modules.scope: Header-only caller-owned auto/safe member-hook intrusive doubly linked list and direct consumer boundary.
modules.non_goals: Full container module, scheduler-private link state machines, native FFI and Formal release certification.
modules.blocker: The frozen candidate has no closure-perf-v1 P1 engineering PASS, and the independent red team has not signed the candidate identity.
modules.resume_condition: Produce one candidate-bound W1-WIN P1 engineering manifest at the frozen 5% margin, then obtain the final candidate identity/red-team verdict without changing the product shape.
known_limitations: The product is limited to 64-bit standard-layout stable-address nodes with external synchronization.
It does not provide reclamation, exact owner tracking, offset pointers or a full STL-like intrusive algorithm suite.
reopen_triggers: A consumer exposes a lifetime or correctness defect.
A supported compiler ABI invalidates member recovery.
A same-contract peer proves a material consumer or complexity advantage after closure.
